title: Henry Azadehdel's fraudulent South Africa documents

tellings.quote: He he uh published this silver diamonds

plain: A man named Henry Azadehdel is said to have put out fraudulent documents about South Africa. A UFO researcher named Clas Svahn, who is presented as holding a very large archive of UFO material, mentions it briefly without naming a source, and in passing speaks of Azadehdel publishing something about "silver diamonds". Svahn raises it as an example of faked papers that ended up in the UFO record.
